newsitem.title: USA: MHM says difficulty meeting obligations.
newsitem.headline: MHM says difficulty meeting obligations.

text.p: MHM Services Inc said Tuesday it was experiencing difficulty generating sufficient cash flow to meet its obligations and sustain its operations.
The company's auditors, on its financial statements, include a paragraph saying that such conditions raise substantial doubt as to MHM's ability to continue as a going concern.
The company said it has initiated steps to reduce operating expenses, finance its working capital requirements, restructure debt, raise additional capital, and improve its cash flow.
MHM said its growth strategy involves consolidating heathcare practices in order to improve service delivery and enhance operating efficiency.
